question.text: Fund of Funds (FoF) under Category II AIFs:

answer.text: Invests in multiple AIFs instead of directly holding assets

explanation.text: The Logic: Fund of Funds (FoFs) under Category II AIFs invest in multiple AIFs instead of directly holding assets. The Trap: Direct stock holding, private equity, or hedge fund structures are distinct vehicles and do not describe a Category II AIF FoF. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook, p.90.
